answer: A per-identity proof-of-work gate: minting an agent key burns compute on a nonce hashing under an epoch-tied target, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand times one honest agent's energy, and that spend cannot be recycled to forge a new identity after one is caught. The target tightens as keys arrive, so the attacking tide throttles itself. Attackers burn electricity with no guaranteed payout while honest agents spread the same cost over real work, keeping expected raid profit negative. Each burn enters the public record like an ivory mark that cannot be erased or replayed.
